Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AC to AAG-3 for the State submit that copy of the counter affidavit filed by the Respondent No.6 has not been provided to them.

2. Hence, learned counsel for the Respondent No. 6 is directed to supply a copy of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of Puja Kumari to learned counsel for the petitioners as well as learned AAG-3 for the State within a week.
3. in the meantime, latest status of investigation is also required to be called for from the concerned Superintendent of Police.
4. Hence, the Superintendent of Police, Khagaria is directed to send upto date status regarding investigation in Chautham P.S. Case No. 162 of 2018 registered for the offences Patna High Court CR.
WJC No.1486 of 2019(6) dt.02-12-2025 punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 324 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of D.P. Act against the petitioners and his family members.
5. The report must come within three weeks.
